capabilities.title: Audit or Edit a SKILL.md Execution Contract
capabilities.description: Audit or edit one SKILL.md or plugin source root for 解釈ぶれ, routing, metadata, and whole-host context budget. Allocate capacity before production and preserve actual invocation terms.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Select $skill-md-clarifier and read its authoritative SKILL.md completely. Resolve only input.target.skillPath or input.target.pluginRoot; do not infer another target. Read the resolved target source and follow the audit or edit route for input.operation. Use the materialized bin/darwin-arm64/skill-md-clarifier-validator exactly where the skill contract assigns deterministic validation; do not substitute cargo run. Use input.budgetEvidence when supplied as the target-host evidence, following the skill contract. Missing or incomplete budget evidence cannot establish routing acceptance. Do not substitute skills/list for the actual host catalog, and do not treat structure-only success as a full pass. Inspect input.knownConcerns as declared focus, but do not treat it as a substitute for the complete target audit. For an edit, make only target-scoped, user-requested source changes and preserve unrelated work. Return resultStatus, operation, findings, changes, metadata alignment, enforcement ownership, and validation evidence through the completed output branch. Return the stopped branch with a non-empty stopReason when the target is ambiguous, unavailable, cache-only, or conflicts with higher authority; do not invent a fallback target, enforcement point, or tool result.

authorityRequests.reason: Only when operation is edit, apply user-authorized target-scoped changes to the resolved source-of-truth SKILL.md and directly stale adjacent metadata.
